question: The AMUL milk cooperative was set up in _______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**1946**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Amul**, which stands for **Anand Milk Union Limited**, was established in the year **1946** in the town of Anand in Gujarat, India.
 
• It was founded under the guidance of **Tribhuvandas Patel**, who was supported by **Sardar Vallabhbhai Patel**. The cooperative was later developed into a model by **Dr. Verghese Kurien**, known as the "Father of the White Revolution" in India.
 
• The primary aim of establishing Amul was to empower rural farmers and eliminate the exploitation by middlemen in the dairy industry, ensuring fair prices for milk producers.
 
• Amul played a pivotal role in India’s **White Revolution**, which transformed the country into the largest producer of milk and dairy products globally.
 
• The cooperative operates under the **Gujarat Cooperative Milk Marketing Federation (GCMMF)** and has become one of the most successful dairy brands in India, known for products like butter, cheese, and milk powder.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **White Revolution:**

 
 
• The White Revolution in India was initiated in the 1970s under the **Operation Flood** program spearheaded by the National Dairy Development Board (NDDB) and Dr. Verghese Kurien.
 
• This revolution significantly boosted milk production in India, making it self-sufficient and the largest producer of milk globally.
 
• It enhanced rural incomes, improved nutrition levels, and contributed to rural development through dairy farming.
 
 
 
• **Tribhuvandas Patel:**
 
 
• He was the **founder chairman** of Amul and played a key role in establishing the cooperative movement in Gujarat.
 
• Patel's efforts were instrumental in organizing local farmers into cooperatives to fight exploitation by milk contractors.
 
 
 
• **Dr. Verghese Kurien:**
 
 
• He is hailed as the "Father of the White Revolution" for his significant contributions to the growth of India’s dairy industry.
 
• Kurien’s leadership in designing and implementing Operation Flood transformed India from a milk-deficient country to a global dairy leader.
 
• He was honored with numerous awards, including the **Ramon Magsaysay Award**, **Padma Shri**, **Padma Bhushan**, and **Padma Vibhushan**.
 
 
 
• **Gujarat Cooperative Milk Marketing Federation (GCMMF):**
 
 
• GCMMF is the apex organization that markets dairy products under the Amul brand.
 
• It is the largest food products organization in India and a significant player in the global dairy industry.
 
• GCMMF’s innovative marketing strategies have made Amul a household name in India.
 
 
 
• **Amul’s Achievements:**
 
 
• Amul introduced India’s first butter and milk powder plant, revolutionizing the dairy industry.
 
• It is renowned for its iconic advertising campaigns, particularly the **Amul Girl** mascot, which has been a part of Indian pop culture for decades.
 
• Amul also played a key role in promoting rural entrepreneurship and uplifting the socio-economic status of dairy farmers.
